item.title: Outside No 40 Dunster Gardens London NW6 7NH, 24th September
item.description:
Tree (ornamental pear) has damaged the front wall to my property causing it to crack. It may also be responsible for cracks to the bay of my house. My structural engineer says it needs urgent pollarding. The trees outside No 44 (ornamental cherry) and No 38 (maple) also need attention. The whole to the pavement in this area needs repair., in particular subsidence at the back of James Stewart House. I would respectfully question why these trees are not pollarded on a regular basis, as are the london planes in Dyne Road. Two weeks ago signs were put up on the other side of the road to limit parking for tree work (the three trees here are small), they were then taken down again, with no work being done. Did you get the wrong address?

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Dunster Gardens, London
Report on FixMyStreet
